body:
Goal: the three project skills (modernize, release, release-audit) are discoverable and executable from Claude Code, Codex CLI and agy, with ONE canonical source so they cannot drift.

Design:
1. Canonical home is skills/<name>/ (already shipped via package.json files and the agy plugin). Move release-audit from .claude/skills/release-audit to skills/release-audit (git mv, keep references/). It is maintainer-internal like release: add metadata.internal: true.
2. scripts/sync-skills.mjs mirrors every skills/<name>/ tree byte-for-byte into .claude/skills/ (Claude Code) and .agents/skills/ (Codex repo scope and agy workspace scope). Copies, never symlinks (Windows, and lib/migrate.mjs rejects skill symlinks). Flags: --check exits 1 on any missing/extra/different file in a mirror, never writes. Only names listed in skills/ plus names recorded in each mirror's .agb-synced.json are managed; foreign skills in those dirs are never touched or deleted. npm script `skills:sync`.
3. .gitignore: replace `.claude/` with `.claude/*` + `!.claude/skills/` + `!.claude/release-profile.md` so the Claude mirror is tracked without force-add.
4. Harness neutrality of SKILL.md bodies: frontmatter keeps name+description (the only keys Codex/agy require; name == dir name, <=64 chars; description single logical line <=1024 chars, so shorten release-audit's). Extra keys (user-invocable, argument-hint, metadata) stay; they are ignored by harnesses that do not know them. Bodies say `the release skill` instead of a bare /release slash command, and every Claude-only tool (Workflow, Artifact, Agent) gets an explicit fallback: Workflow -> run the same per-unit prompts as sequential/parallel subagents if the harness has them, else sequentially in-session; Artifact -> write the report to <scratch>/release-audit-<version>.html or .md and print the path.
5. scripts/release-audit-workflow.mjs: update WORKFLOW_MD to skills/release-audit/references/workflow-script.md; add a `--prompts` mode that emits the per-unit prompts+schemas as JSON so non-Claude harnesses can drive the fan-out without the Workflow tool. Must not change default behaviour.
6. Tests (test/skills-cross-harness.test.mjs, node --test, offline): every skills/*/SKILL.md has valid frontmatter per rule 4; mirrors are in sync (`sync-skills --check` exits 0); sync copies, detects drift, preserves foreign skills; no SKILL.md body contains a harness-only invocation without a fallback sentence (grep for Workflow(/Artifact tool). Update test/release-audit-skill.test.mjs SKILL_DIR to skills/release-audit.
7. Docs: CHANGELOG Unreleased, CONTRIBUTING (edit skills/ only, run skills:sync), website skills.mdx note; regenerate website partials with `cd website && node scripts/gen-reference.mjs`.

Constraints: do not touch lib/lock.mjs, lib/gates.mjs, .adlc/config.json, CODEOWNERS. No new dependencies. No vendored ADLC doctrine skills.

Acceptance: A. `npm test` passes. B. `node scripts/sync-skills.mjs --check` exits 0, and exits 1 after editing a mirror file. C. `ls .claude/skills .agents/skills` both list modernize release release-audit. D. `cd website && node scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check` exits 0. E. `adlc rails-guard --base main --rails lib/lock.mjs --rails lib/gates.mjs` reports rails untouched.

Amendment (found during build): spec Appendix A D9 deleted the legacy .agents/ tree (sidecars/skills/agents sources). Codex and agy discover repo skills at .agents/skills/, so the mirror reintroduces that directory. D9's intent (no second editable copy of sidecars/agents/skills sources) is preserved by tightening test/plugin-layout.test.mjs and test/unit.test.mjs from 'no .agents/' to '.agents/ holds only the generated skills mirror (skills/ + .agb-synced.json at its root)'. Owner to confirm this D9 amendment at review.
title: Make every project skill run in Claude Code, Codex and agy from one canonical source
